name: Unlimited Welcome
description: Verizon's lowest-priced myPlan unlimited plan. Data is unlimited but has no premium allowance, so it may slow when the network is busy, and there's no hotspot. Becomes much cheaper per line with more lines.
international: Calls to Mexico & Canada; talk, text & data in Mexico & Canada; texts to 200+ countries

deals.title: $10/mo off with 3+ new lines
deals.details: Verizon gives a $10/mo account credit for 36 months when you add 3 or more new lines (Unlimited Welcome shows as $27.50/line with 4 new lines).
